newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 27.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for May 27.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Tuesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and light rains along Michoacan, Guerrero, Oaxaca and Chiapas state coasts. Maximum winds of 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to five feet high.
Expected rain and electric storms along most of coast. Predominant winds 10 to 15 knots and waves from three to five feet.
Hot and partly cloudy with scattered rains expected this evening. Winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
